title: September agent bootstrap and child bus program
mission: Create the durable September program for reversible agent bootstrap (Inspect/Apply/Remove), provider-neutral child execution (Pi/OpenCode adapters via shared bus), fresh-TUI LSP runtime certification, heterogeneous and nested delegation, and stale-owner convergence without leaking workstation-specific evidence into public coordination artifacts.

owner.surface: September agent bootstrap and child bus program

safeParallelWork: Panel 02 TUI LSP runtime certification (local untracked runtime-smoke evidence only) with Panels 03 Pi reversible bootstrap and 04 shared child bus spine after the coordination floor, provided their declared ownership surfaces remain disjoint
Child-repository feature work using separate branches and worktrees outside plans/** and .ai/WORK_QUEUE.md
ownedScope: PR-disposition metadata for merged PR #151, merged PR #149, and stale PR #115
forbiddenScope: rewriting merged PR #151 or #149 history or closing PR #115 before supersession proof
committing private local paths, usernames, tenant details, runtime receipts, or machine evidence
expectedArtifacts: collision ledger covering merged PR #151, merged PR #149, stale PR #115 and shared ownership surfaces
public-plan + repository-work-ledger privacy and contract proof

tasks.title: Establish and reconcile September coordination floor
acceptanceCriteria: Coordination floor commit 38fd434 is retained as an ancestor of current main and current provider truth is refreshed before reconciliation
Plan and ledger encode the 10-panel September program with waves, dependencies, collision surfaces, proof ceilings, and current PR states
Public coordination files contain no private absolute Windows user path or tenant-labelled OneDrive path
PR #151 and #149 are recorded as merged current-main inputs, while PR #115 remains a stale open owner pending supersession proof
Plan/ledger/privacy validators pass

tasks.title: OpenCode fresh-TUI LSP runtime certification
outputs: local opencode-lsp-runtime-smoke.json/.md beneath the registered local evidence root
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh TUI launched from the current canonical checkout with OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_LSP_TOOL=true, tests/test_technician_live_cert_surface.py opened, strict hover/definition/references captured with nonLspSemanticFallbackUsed No and verbatim errors
Headless/TUI comparison yields PASS_TUI_HEADLESS_DIFFERENTIAL, FAIL_BOTH_MODES, PARTIAL_TUI_DIFFERENTIAL, or BLOCKED_OPERATOR_INTERACTION
No tracked harness mutation unless the TUI exposes a reproducible product defect

tasks.title: Pi reversible system bootstrap lifecycle
outputs: Pi Inspect/Apply/Remove parity using the shared lifecycle contract
acceptanceCriteria: Pi is registered in tooling/harness/system-bootstrap-lifecycle/adapters.v1.json without redesigning the shared contract
Inspect/Apply/Remove use durable machine ownership, write-ahead intent, drift fail-closed semantics, and resumable rollback checkpoints
Remove preserves provider credentials, Pi settings, sessions, project trust, and unrelated state
evidence: merge:1f20499d5771456c9ce88da67eced345899928fa installed Pi bootstrap/child seam on main; lifecycle registry still requires a Pi adapter

tasks.title: Shared ASB child bus v1 contract spine
outputs: tooling/harness/child-agent-bus/ request/result/error schemas, adapter registry, artifact registry, fixtures, validator, dispatcher, docs and CI
acceptanceCriteria: Closed provider-neutral child-agent-request.v1, child-agent-result.v1 and child-agent-error.v1 schemas define invocation lineage, authority, budgets and evidence root
Generic Invoke-AgentSwitchboardChild front door validates the request and fails closed when an adapter is absent
Common validator and fixture matrix cover read-only, isolated writer, dirty/default-branch/base-SHA mismatch, budget exhaustion, timeout and missing terminal-event cases

tasks.title: Pi child adapter conformance
outputs: Pi adapter registered on the common bus
acceptanceCriteria: Pi becomes a conforming implementation of the shared bus instead of retaining a private canonical request/result protocol
Read-only no-mutation and writer isolated-worktree guards remain enforced; terminal agent_end, budgets and evidence uniqueness are preserved
evidence: merge:1f20499d5771456c9ce88da67eced345899928fa supplies the current Pi-private adapter source

tasks.title: OpenCode child adapter parity
inputs: Pi adapter as conformance reference when available
outputs: parity matrix against common conformance fixtures
acceptanceCriteria: OpenCode consumes the same provider-neutral request and produces the same normalized result/error envelopes as Pi
Exact managed runtime identity is used without arbitrary PATH or provider/model fallback

tasks.title: Heterogeneous read-only pilot (Pi + OpenCode)
inputs: both adapters merged and physically ready plus provider authentication
acceptanceCriteria: Pi architect and OpenCode validator are dispatched through ASB with distinct invocation IDs/evidence roots, enforced budgets, terminal completion evidence, and an unchanged repository

tasks.title: Mediated nested delegation v1 (maxDepth 2)
outputs: nested delegation v1 contract with maxDepth2, maxChildren3, maxConcurrentWriters1, attempts1, no fallback, no child merge/push
acceptanceCriteria: Authority only narrows downward; budget/scope inheritance, cancellation cascade, evidence root reservation, depth limits and one-writer semantics are deterministic

tasks.title: Nested runtime certification (depth-2 heterogeneous chain)
acceptanceCriteria: One bounded depth-2 heterogeneous chain is proven with lineage, narrowed scope/budget, independent evidence roots, and provider authentication without storing secrets

outputs: merged #151 behavior reconciled to lifecycle + shared-bus successors
merged #149 path-authority behavior reconciled with current operator workflow without history rewrite
PR #115 superseded closure when containment is proven
